lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Good morning, Hyunju! You look a little tired. Did you sleep well last night?
lines.ko: 좋은 아침이에요, 현주 씨! 조금 피곤해 보이네요. 어젯밤에 잘 잤어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I didn't sleep well. I think I'm very stressed.
lines.ko: 아니요, 잘 못 잤어요. 스트레스를 많이 받는 것 같아요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. What do you usually do after work?
lines.ko: 저런, 안됐네요. 퇴근하고 나서 보통 뭐 해요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: After work, I just zone out on the sofa for two hours and watch short videos.
lines.ko: 퇴근하면 그냥 두 시간 동안 소파에서 멍하니 짧은 영상만 봐요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Ha ha, me too! It's easy to keep scrolling. But it can make you even more tired. Do you do any exercise?
lines.ko: 하하, 저도요! 계속 화면을 넘기게 되죠. 그런데 그러면 더 피곤해질 수 있어요. 운동은 해요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Before, when I wasn't so stressed, I used to ride my bike for an hour after work.
lines.ko: 예전에 스트레스를 덜 받을 때는 퇴근 후에 한 시간씩 자전거를 탔어요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Oh, you used to ride a bike? That's great! Why don't you start again? Maybe just twenty minutes a day. What do you think?
lines.ko: 아, 자전거를 탔었어요? 좋네요! 다시 시작해 보는 건 어때요? 하루에 이십 분만이라도요. 어때요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: That's a good idea. I'm going to ride my bike to the store or the library for twenty minutes.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 이십 분 정도 자전거를 타고 가게나 도서관에 가 볼게요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: That's a smart idea! You can exercise and do your errands at the same time. Let me know how it goes. Good luck, Hyunju!
lines.ko: 좋은 방법이네요! 운동도 하고 볼일도 같이 볼 수 있잖아요. 어땠는지 알려 줘요. 화이팅, 현주 씨!

vocab.example: I just zone out on the sofa for two hours.
I used to ride my bike for an hour after work.
I'm going to ride my bike to the store.
I'll ride my bike to the store or the library.
You can exercise and do your errands at the same time.
